results.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging by your sides and palms facing backward.
Raise the right dumbbell in front of you until your arm is parallel to the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Lower the right dumbbell back to the starting position and then raise the left dumbbell in front of you until your arm is parallel to the floor.
Continue alternating the raise between your right and left arms for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use a controlled motion to avoid swinging the weights and maintain proper form.
Keep your head and neck in a neutral position, looking straight ahead.
Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to reduce joint strain.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Vertical Front Raises
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging straight down by your sides, palms facing your body.
Raise the right dumbbell in front of you, keeping your arm straight but not locked, until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower the right dumbbell back to the starting position and then raise the left dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height.
Continue alternating the raise between your right and left arms for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use a controlled motion to avoid swinging the weights and maintain proper form.
Keep your head and neck in a neutral position, looking straight ahead.
Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to reduce joint strain.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Vertical Front Raises is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Behind Back Shoulders Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Your hands should be at a level behind your neck with your palms facing forward and elbows bent.
Press the dumbbells upward overhead by extending your arms fully.
Squeeze your shoulders at the top of the movement, ensuring your arms are fully extended and in line with your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you press the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them.
Use a controlled motion to avoid using momentum to lift the weights.
Keep your head and neck in a neutral position, looking straight ahead.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Behind Back Shoulders Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Curl Arnold Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand, positioned just in front of your shoulders. Your elbows should be facing down, and your palms facing your shoulders.
Press the dumbbells overhead while rotating your wrists so your palms face forward, fully extending your arms at the top of the movement.
Reverse the movement by lowering the dumbbells back to shoulder level, rotating your wrists back to the starting position.
Repeat the press and rotation for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control, focusing on the rotation of your wrists.
Avoid using momentum to lift the dumbbells; focus on muscle engagement.
Maintain a slight bend in your knees for better balance.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Curl Arnold Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Front Raise Above Head
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip (palms facing down). Let your arms hang straight down in front of your hips.
Raise both dumbbells simultaneously in front of you, keeping your arms straight and lifting until the dumbbells are above your head.
Hold the position briefly at the top, ensuring your arms are fully extended above your head.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control, keeping your movements slow and steady. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you raise the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
Avoid using momentum; focus on controlled movements.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows to reduce strain on your joints.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Front Raise Above Head is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Chest.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height to your sides, with your palms facing forward and elbows bent.
Press the dumbbells overhead by extending your arms fully without locking your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height in a controlled motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement.
Breathe out as you press the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them.
Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Overhead Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Palms in Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at head height with your palms facing each other and elbows bent.
Press the dumbbells overhead by extending your arms fully without locking your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells back to head height in a controlled motion, keeping your core engaged and back straight.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement.
Breathe out as you press the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them.
Use a controlled motion to avoid shoulder injury.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Palms in Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Upright Shoulder External Rotation (Front View)
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand. Bend your right elbow to 90 degrees, keeping your elbow at shoulder level, extended to your side and lower your forearm vertical to the floor.
Keep your elbow fixed at your side and slowly rotate your forearm upward, raising the dumbbell until your forearm is up vertical to the floor.
Slowly return the dumbbell to the starting position by rotating your forearm down. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left arm and repeat.
tips: Use a lightweight dumbbell to avoid strain and maintain proper form.
Focus on a slow and controlled movement to engage the rotator cuff muscles effectively.
Avoid using momentum; ensure the movement is controlled by your shoulder muscles.
results.description: Dumbbell Upright Shoulder External Rotation (Front View) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Upright Shoulder External Rotation
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand. Bend your right elbow to 90 degrees, keeping your elbow at shoulder level, extended to your side and lower your forearm vertical to the floor.
Keep your elbow fixed at your side and slowly rotate your forearm upward, raising the dumbbell until your forearm is up vertical to the floor.
Slowly return the dumbbell to the starting position by rotating your forearm down. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left arm and repeat.
tips: Use a lightweight dumbbell to avoid strain and maintain proper form.
Focus on a slow and controlled movement to engage the rotator cuff muscles effectively.
Avoid using momentum; ensure the movement is controlled by your shoulder muscles.
results.description: Dumbbell Upright Shoulder External Rotation is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell W Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Bend your elbows at 90 degrees to bring the dumbbells up to shoulder height, with palms facing forward. Elbows should be pointing out and lower than shoulder level.
Raise the dumbbells upward, in an arc motion, until both dumbbells are above your head.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, keeping your elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Repeat the exercise for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your movements are controlled and avoid using momentum.
Exhale as you press the dumbbells upward and inhale as you lower them back down.
Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell W Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Back.
